doc:
**Erdős–Szekeres theorem.** If `n > r * s`, every injective sequence `f : Fin n → α` into a
linear order has a strictly increasing subsequence of length `r + 1` or a strictly decreasing
subsequence of length `s + 1`.
pretty:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [inst : @LinearOrder α] →
    {r s n : Nat} →
      (f : Fin n → α) →
        @Function.Injective (Fin n) α f →
          @LT.lt Nat instLTNat (@HMul.hMul Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul Nat instMulNat) r s) n →
            Or
              (@Exists (@Finset (Fin n)) fun t =>
                And (@Eq Nat (@Finset.card (Fin n) t) (@HAdd.hAdd Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd Nat instAddNat) r 1))
                  (@StrictMonoOn (Fin n) α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder (Fin n) (Fin.instPartialOrder n))
                    (@PartialOrder.toPreorder α
                      (@SemilatticeInf.toPartialOrder α
                        (@Lattice.toSemilatticeInf α
                          (@DistribLattice.toLattice α (@instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder α inst)))))
                    f (@SetLike.coe (@Finset (Fin n)) (Fin n) (@Finset.instSetLike (Fin n)) t)))
              (@Exists (@Finset (Fin n)) fun t =>
                And (@Eq Nat (@Finset.card (Fin n) t) (@HAdd.hAdd Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd Nat instAddNat) s 1))
                  (@StrictAntiOn (Fin n) α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder (Fin n) (Fin.instPartialOrder n))
                    (@PartialOrder.toPreorder α
                      (@SemilatticeInf.toPartialOrder α
                        (@Lattice.toSemilatticeInf α
                          (@DistribLattice.toLattice α (@instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder α inst)))))
                    f (@SetLike.coe (@Finset (Fin n)) (Fin n) (@Finset.instSetLike (Fin n)) t)))
